title: Era of Civilization
body:
This is a collection of mods designed to make setting up for [Era of Civilization](https://discord.gg/mfeqfBVw62) as straightforward as possible. All mods shown here are permitted for use on the server.

Types of mods:
- Optimization (Sodium, EntityCulling, etc.)
- Features (Simple Voice Chat, Distant Horizons)
- Visual Enhancements (Iris, Continuity, ETF, EMF)

**IMPORTANT NOTE**:
- Concurrent Chunk Management Engine
- VeryManyPlayers

These mods can improve game performance, but are incompatible with Flashback when loading replays. It is recommended to keep these mods enabled until you need to look at replays, then disable them. If you don't want to deal with the hassle, disable or remove them altogether.![Flashback Incompatibility](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0188d14ab489f0bf10c0b36f327bec883e2b3169.jpeg)Note that you can still configure Flashback while having these mods enabled: Go to Mods, scroll to Flashback, and click on its icon.![Configure Flashback](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ae1b64848421d62cd9a817a70f461b33b06dc95.jpeg)
